RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 20

The committee's gender composition alone is not evidence of bias; panels are typically formed based on availability, subfield relevance, or administrative rotations. Lecturer appointments prioritize teaching effectiveness, curriculum fit, and practical experience over raw publication counts, making industry background a compelling qualification. 

Raising the panel's gender as a grievance without concrete evidence will appear unfounded and could severely damage your academic reputation. Delays of two weeks for hiring feedback are also common due to administrative backlogs. Instead, send a polite follow-up requesting constructive feedback focused on how to strengthen future applications.
